 Cameron Johnson racks up 18 points in win over Pacers 
 by Garrett Ball | Nuggets Correspondent | Sun, Nov 8th 2026, 8:01am EST 
 Cameron Johnson scored 18 points (8-12 FG, 2-5 3P) with four rebounds, an assist, and a steal in the Nuggets' 114-102 win over the Pacers on Saturday. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 It was Johnson's best game of the season so far, eclipsing the 12 points he had against Toronto on Wednesday. He should continue to have performances like this as he ramps up and gets up to game speed.
